newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PENNU COMPUTER TO MIX USE OF SHARE ISSUE FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: PENNU COMPUTER TO MIX USE OF SHARE ISSUE FUNDS.

text.p: Pennu Computer Technology (PCT) said on Thursday it will use funds raised via a share issue to fund its leasing service, its real estate joint venture as well as the company's general development.
PCT, which is listed on the Tallinn Stock Exchange's secondary list, plans to raise 19.1 million kroons from the share issue which opened for offers this month and closes on March 31.
The company said in a statement that four million kroons will be invested into its wholly-owned leasing service.
The other six million kroons will be used to buy 50 percent of the Jarve Real Estate Administration which is to build a business centre for lease.
The remaining funds will be used to develop the company and speed up its growth, PCT said.
